request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. 116 BPM, D-centred polytonal quodlibet. Clearly separated short episodes of bronze bell and harp, forged metal and cello, celesta canon, broken pizzicato and organ, low horn and muted snare. Tiny bells and celesta suggest falling keys. Later force the Silent Toll into an oppressive orchestral unison, challenged by plucked Crimson Thread, then thin back to a single distant wordless treble voice. No lyrics. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
